function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search what Jarvis has been told and remembers.

function.name: shell_exec
function.description: Run one shell command on this machine and return its output.

function.name: control_computer
function.description: Click or type inside another Windows program, by naming its on-screen controls. Reads the target window first; a control that cannot be found is reported, not guessed at.

function.name: control_phone
function.description: Tap, swipe, type, press a key, or take a screenshot on the owner's own paired Android phone over adb.

function.name: github_search
function.description: Check whether a library or approach for a coding idea already exists on GitHub, graded by maintenance and licence, before building it from scratch.

function.name: calendar_read
function.description: Read the owner's own calendar (CalDAV) for the next N days - event titles, times, and locations. Read-only; never creates or changes an event.

days_ahead.description: how many days ahead to look, default 7, max 90

function.name: email_check
function.description: Check the owner's own IMAP inbox for recent messages - sender, subject, date, and a short plain-text preview of each. Read-only; never sends, replies to, deletes, or marks anything.

unread_only.description: true (default) for unread mail only, false for all

function.name: notes_search
function.description: Search the owner's own notes: the Obsidian vault folder on this PC, or Joplin or Obsidian over each app's local REST API. Read-only; never creates or edits a note.

function.name: home_read
function.description: Read the current state of specific, named Home Assistant entities - never the whole house at once. Read-only.

function.name: home_control
function.description: Call one Home Assistant service on one named entity - turn a light on, unlock a door, and so on. This changes something real, not just data; a lock, alarm, or cover action is treated as especially consequential.

function.name: append_logseq_journal
function.description: Add one entry to the end of today's Logseq journal page on this PC. Only ever adds; never changes or removes anything already written.

text.description: the entry, in the owner's words

function.name: append_obsidian_daily
function.description: Add one entry to the end of today's Obsidian daily note on this PC. Only ever adds; never changes or removes anything already written.

text.description: the entry, in the owner's words

function.name: create_joplin_note
function.description: Create one NEW note in Joplin on this PC. Never edits an existing note and never creates a notebook.

notebook.description: an existing notebook's exact name; omit for Joplin's default
